# Frontend (Nuxt 3 + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn-vue)

The source files here are complete. The `package.json`, `node_modules` and the
shadcn component files are generated by the commands below, because they depend on the
package versions available when you install.

## Setup (npm; follow the same order)

```bash
# 1. From the repo root, create a Nuxt project in a TEMP folder to get package.json etc.
npm create nuxt@latest frontend-tmp        # pick npm, skip modules/git when asked

# 2. Move its generated files into frontend/ WITHOUT overwriting ours
#    (copy package.json, tsconfig.json, .gitignore, public/ if present)
#    then delete frontend-tmp and its default app.vue / app/ folder.

cd frontend
npm install
npm i -D tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite typescript
npx nuxi@latest module add shadcn-nuxt
npx nuxi prepare
npx shadcn-vue@latest init                 # base color: Neutral
npx shadcn-vue@latest add button card input label textarea badge

cp .env.example .env                       # set NUXT_PUBLIC_RECAPTCHA_SITE_KEY
npm run dev                                # http://localhost:3000
```

Notes
* `shadcn-vue init` appends the theme variables (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, ...)
  to `assets/css/tailwind.css`. Keep the `@import "tailwindcss";` line at the top.
* If your Nuxt version has `app/` as the source folder, our `srcDir: '.'` in
  `nuxt.config.ts` keeps the files at the project root working.
* The backend must be running on `NUXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE` (default http://localhost:8000),
  and the backend `.env` `FRONTEND_URL` must be http://localhost:3000 (CORS).
* Google OAuth redirect URI (Google Cloud Console): `http://localhost:8000/auth/google/callback`.

## Pages (route -> who can open it)

| Route | Roles | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `/`, `/gigs` | public | landing, browse approved gigs (cached by the API) |
| `/login`, `/auth/callback` | public | reCAPTCHA + Google sign-in |
| `/dashboard/client` | client | stats, quick links |
| `/dashboard/freelancer` | freelancer | bids, contracts, earnings |
| `/dashboard/admin` | admin | moderation, escrow and payout overview |
| `/gigs/new`, `/gigs/[id]/edit`, `/my/gigs` | client | create, update, delete, list own gigs |
| `/gigs/[id]` | logged in | details; freelancer bids; client compares and selects |
| `/my/bids` | freelancer | bid list (edit / withdraw on the gig page) |
| `/contracts`, `/contracts/[id]` | parties + admin | pay, submit link, approve, ticket thread |
| `/payouts` | freelancer | own payout records |
| `/profile`, `/profiles/[id]` | logged in | profile, PSGC address, portfolio |
| `/admin/gigs`, `/admin/users`, `/admin/payouts` | admin | approvals, user management, manual payouts |

## Frontend security notes

* Route middleware (`middleware/auth.ts`) checks login and `definePageMeta({ roles })`.
  This is for user experience only; the FastAPI backend enforces every rule again.
* All user text is rendered with `{{ }}` (escaped by Vue). `v-html` is never used.
* The JWT lives in a `SameSite=Strict` cookie. It is not HttpOnly (the SPA must read it), which is
  why XSS prevention (no `v-html`, backend text cleaning, CSP) matters. Say this in your documentation.
* Only public values are in `frontend/.env`; no secrets.
